data.service_description: Underground contract mining (bord and pillar, continuous miner), drill and blast, and plant operations management. Positions itself as a full outsourced coal mining services provider enabling clients to reduce labour risk and operating costs.
known_clients: Undisclosed collieries in Mpumalanga / Ermelo district
data.recent_contracts_or_disputes: No publicly confirmed specific contracts post-2023; company continues active marketing of underground mining outsourcing in Mpumalanga coalfields.
data.notes: Directly comparable to CPI â€” coal-specialist underground labour and plant management outsourcer.

data.service_description: BBBEE Level 1 underground coal mining contractor providing comprehensive underground mining services including mine development, stoping, and plant management. JV between Cementation Africa (formerly Murray & Roberts Cementation, 49%) and Amandla TM (51%, 100% Black-owned).
data.recent_contracts_or_disputes: Awarded R3.2-billion underground mining services contract at Arnot Coal Mine (June 2021, multi-year). Boipelo also held the New Clydesdale Colliery underground contract. Parent company Cementation Africa rebranded from Murray & Roberts Cementation effective July 2025 following acquisition by Differential Capital consortium.
data.notes: Highest-profile coal underground management contractor in SA. Scale and BBBEE credentials make it a tier-1 competitor for large operational management tenders.

data.service_description: Opencast contract mining and plant management specialist. Services include drill and blast, load and haul, crushing and screening, and ROM coal production. One of the largest private equipment fleets in Africa. Produces over 1 million tonnes ROM coal monthly across active Mpumalanga and Waterberg contracts.
known_clients: Various Waterberg and Soutpansberg coal clients
data.recent_contracts_or_disputes: Multiple active long-term opencast coal contracts in Mpumalanga and Limpopo. No publicly reported labour disputes as of mid-2026.
data.notes: Primarily opencast focus; less direct overlap with CPI's plant operations management model but competes for surface processing contracts.

data.service_description: Full pit-to-port contract mining services including resource modelling, mine planning, drill and blast, load and haul, crushing and screening, beneficiation, rail loadout management, and logistics. Part of JSE-listed Afrimat Ltd.
known_clients: Various undisclosed coal clients in Mpumalanga
data.recent_contracts_or_disputes: Actively expanding mining services division. No public labour disputes. Operates 4 DTH drill rigs 24/7 at Nkomati achieving ~600,000 cbm overburden monthly.
data.notes: JSE-listed backing gives Afrimat financial stability and bonding capacity competitive advantage. Vertically integrated model preferred by large mining houses.

data.notes: Fastest-growing Black-owned coal services contractor in Mpumalanga â€” BBBEE advantage increasingly decisive in Exxaro, Seriti, and Thungela procurement.

data.service_description: Large-scale mining labour outsourcing and TES (Temporary Employment Services) provider. Supplies permanent and temporary staff, manages contractor workforces, payroll, IR, HR, employee benefits, and health services. Recognised Top Employer 2026. Subsidiary of JSE AltX-listed Workforce Holdings Limited.
known_clients: Undisclosed â€” serves clients across manufacturing, logistics, mining, and renewable energy sectors
data.recent_contracts_or_disputes: No specific mining contract disclosures publicly available. Employs over 1,100 permanent staff and pays approximately 35,000 temporary contractors weekly across all sectors.
data.notes: Competes with CPI on pure labour deployment (TES) side rather than operational plant management. Largest scale TES competitor in the SA mining labour space.
